title: Welcome Matthew Bailey, New Community President at the Milwaukee Branch

# Welcome Matthew Bailey, New Community President at the Milwaukee Branch


2 minutes read


**Posted:** November 3, 2026


**Wauwatosa, Wis. – November 3, 2026** – WaterStone Bank is pleased to announce that Matthew Bailey has joined the bank as Community President of its Milwaukee branch, serving customers and businesses in the 68th St. and Oklahoma Ave. area.


Matthew brings more than a decade of banking, management and training experience to the role. Since 2024, he served as Community Bank Manager for TriCity National Bank in Bay View. He spent the eight years prior to that with Advance America in southeastern Wisconsin as a Divisional Training Manager and three years with Wells Fargo Bank in Milwaukee as a Personal Banker.


“Matthew brings a strong combination of banking experience, leadership and knowledge of the Milwaukee community to this position,” said Erin McCarthy, AVP/Sr. Regional Manager. “We are excited to welcome him to a branch that is important to WaterStone and the customers we serve. The surrounding area offers an exciting mix of residential neighborhoods and commercial activity, and we look forward to having Matthew lead our team as we continue building relationships in the community.”


Matthew has completed Management and Leadership Development certificate coursework through the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and Banking & Financial Institution certificate coursework through the University of Illinois. He is also a notary and a Wells Fargo Circle of Stars Award recipient.


Outside of banking, Matthew volunteers with Feeding America. He is also a T.R.U.S.T.-certified recreational drone pilot and enjoys flying unmanned aircraft in his free time. A Milwaukee-area favorite is the lakefront.


## Matthew Bailey


With extensive experience in banking and leadership, along with strong ties to the Milwaukee area, Matthew is helping us build lasting relationships with customers, businesses and the community.


**About WaterStone Bank**
WaterStone Bank, established in 1921, is a leading financial institution committed to serving the communities of Milwaukee, Waukesha, and Washington Counties. With a proud history of innovation, integrity, and community service, WaterStone Bank offers a wide range of banking and financial solutions to both individual and business customers. Headquartered in Wauwatosa, Wisconsin, the bank operates 14 branches across the region and is recognized for its commitment to customer service and community involvement. For more information, please visit our website at[wsbonline.com](https://www.wsbonline.com/) .
